description: The DAW's local collaboration contract. A host program (Agent One) drives it over the DAW's MCP server (loopback, off unless enabled in Preferences). Tool names and parameters below are frozen for version 1; any change needs agentdaw.local/2. Copyright the AGENT DAW protocol authors, Apache-2.0.

tools.name: collab_export_manifest
tools.returns: manifest JSON string (agentdaw.manifest/1). Errors if the project was never saved or has unsaved edits.

tools.name: collab_apply_manifest
tools.returns: {applied, errors[], warnings[], tracks}. Never changes the project unless applied is true.

rules: The DAW holds no collaboration policy, credentials or network code behind this contract.
A read never changes the project. Applying requires an explicit confirmation and refuses over unsaved edits unless told to discard them.
Reserved items are listed so a host can tell 'not implemented' from 'unknown'; capabilities lists only what is implemented.

audio_tap.endpoint: GET /audio/tap on the DAW's loopback server
audio_tap.refuses: any request with an Origin header, or a Host other than loopback; a second listener while one is connected (409)
audio_tap.format: first line JSON {format:'f32le',channels:2,sampleRate,capacityFrames}, then messages: u8 type, u32le payload length, payload; type 1 = interleaved stereo float32 frames, type 2 = u64 total frames dropped
audio_tap.notes: A server notices a closed connection late (about 2 s), so a client reconnecting after a disconnect should retry on 409.
